hero.title: How Finland’s pension system is funded
hero.lead: A calm, evidence-led walkthrough of funding flows and reserves—built for clarity, not dashboards.

fundingOverview.title: Funding overview
fundingOverview.lead: Finland’s statutory earnings-related pensions are partly funded through invested reserves held by employment pension schemes. The stock of those financial assets is one useful lens on how large the system’s buffer has become over time.
fundingOverview.highlight: At year-end {year}, employment pension schemes held about {amount} in financial assets (national accounts, stock positions).
fundingOverview.attribution: Source: Statistics Finland, national financial accounts (RTP), sector S13141 employment pension schemes, instrument total financial assets (F0), million euros.

signatureViz.title: Pension assets over time
signatureViz.deck: Total financial assets on employment pension schemes’ balance sheets, as recorded in Finland’s national accounts. Values are stock positions at year-end, not annual flows.
signatureViz.caption: National accounts figures are revised as methods and source data improve; the latest year is sometimes provisional. Axis shows billions of euro.
signatureViz.ariaLabel: Line chart of employment pension scheme financial assets from {from} to {to}.

MethodologyPage.title: Methodology
MethodologyPage.intro: Phase 2 uses a reproducible path: official PxWeb extracts are stored raw, validated, normalized into a processed JSON artifact, then transformed into chart view models. This page will gain fuller methodology text in a later phase.
